context_requirements: Proliferating cells with intact Ca2+/calmodulin-dependent G1/S and mitotic progression
Sufficient intracellular calmodulin availability and calcium signaling
Cell lines not already growth-arrested or quiescent
falsifiers: No decrease in proliferation-associated landmark genes (e.g., MYC, CCND1, MCM3, PCNA) at 24 h in any responsive line
No increase in CDKN1A or GADD45A at 24 h despite drug exposure
Transcriptional responses indistinguishable from vehicle across all nine lines at both time points
Predominant upregulation of proliferation genes rather than downregulation

evidence.supports: Calmodulin antagonist W-7 inhibits cell proliferation and G1/S progression
Calmodulin antagonist R24571 causes G1 accumulation in MCF-7 cells
Calmodulin antagonist W-13 inhibits growth of breast cancer cell lines including MCF-7 and ER-negative lines
